      "login": "andrewtoth",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "Concerned about repeated pool locking in a loop via pool->exists and separating counter increments"

      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "removing the extrapool decrement assumes the candidate came from the extrapool when it might have been inserted during mempool scan",
      "quote": "removing this decrement assumes that the existing candidate came from the extrapool. However, it may have been inserted during the earlier mempool scan.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "fixed after #35727 was merged",

      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3855525644",
      "status_by_quote": "marking as resolvesed since #35727 was merged and I've updated this PR based on that."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3817463631",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "contradictory logging levels by calling LogDebug inside a ShouldTraceLog check",
      "quote": "The code has contradictory logging levels: if (ShouldTraceLog(...)) { LogDebug(...); }",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author formatted into a single log line",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3877016279"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3877016279",
      "status_by_quote": "Thanks, I've made it one log line instead."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3839305247",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "unnecessary code complexity by separating count increments from reconstruction logic",
      "quote": "Incrementing the counts inline is very cheap. I can't see it be worth the code complexity to move these out.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained moving count logic was for readability and scoping logging code, not performance",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3858093382"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3858093382",
      "status_by_quote": "I moved the count inc/dec out because I thought it made the code easier to read, not for performance."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3839314405",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "add a comment that these variables will only be set if debug logging is enabled",
      "quote": "We should have a comment here that these will only be set if debug logging is enabled.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added the requested comment",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3877014117", "rc:3877015466"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3877014117",
      "status_by_quote": "Thanks, fixed."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3839456791",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "checking prefill existence via pool->exists acquires pool->cs repeatedly in a loop instead of checking under a single lock",
      "quote": "Instead of calling pool->exists for each prefill (which takes the pool lock each time), we can take call GetIter after we take the pool lock later.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author adopted the suggested std::map approach under a single lock and pushed the change",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4030006348", "rc:4226558051"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4226558051",
      "status_by_quote": "OK, thanks for patience here, this is much better and I've taken it"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3829480388",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "format all requested txids into a single comma-separated log line",
      "quote": "does it make sense to put all txids, maybe comma separated, into a single line?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author combined txids into a single log line",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3877016279"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3877016279",
      "status_by_quote": "Thanks, I've made it one log line instead."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4030272874",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "fix copy-paste error in log message for extrapool transactions",
      "quote": "\"%u txn (%u bytes) were present in the extrapool.\"",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author fixed the log string",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4226558393"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4226558393",
      "status_by_quote": "Oops, copy paste mistake, thanks for catching, fixed."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4030276504",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "include the block hash in the log message",
      "quote": "Would be good to have a block hash here too",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added block hash to the log line",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4226558714"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4226558714",
      "status_by_quote": "Good catch, I have had to write debug.log parsing state trackers before"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4030301159",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "reuse the debug_log boolean variable instead of rechecking",
      "quote": "You can probably reuse debug_log",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author reused debug_log",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4226558956"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4226558956",
      "status_by_quote": "Taken, thank you."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4030420584",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "use util::Join to format txids in the log message",
      "quote": "might be a bit cleaner. Needs `#include <util/string.h>.`",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author adopted util::Join",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4226559544"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4226559544",
      "status_by_quote": "That's awesome, thank you."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4030470122",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "format missing transactions log message onto a single line",
      "quote": "might make sense to change this into one long line too?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author formatted into a single line",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4226560058"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4226560058",
      "status_by_quote": "Done, and used the same thing you suggested above."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4233596541",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "whether the Assume can be hit during fuzzing or when running with assert-on-assume",
      "quote": "I'm not sure if this `Assume` can ever be hit in fuzzing.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    }
  ],

      "areas": []

  ],

  "notes": "The author pushed changes incorporating andrewtoth's single-lock std::map approach and multiple logging formatting suggestions from 0xB10C. 0xB10C provided a code review ACK while raising a question about Assume behavior under fuzzing."
